title: Story premise EDU034: The Mixed-Tool Workshop
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: Which tool fits when the shelf stops telling you? Takeaway/theme: Choosing a method is a separate skill from carrying out a known method.
description: An apprentice wants to choose the right method for each puzzle, but grouped practice lets the shelf label make every choice. Mixed puzzle cards remove that cue and require a reason before selecting a tool.
